title: Unity - Manual: Dedicated Server optimizations
excerpts: matic optimizations By default, the Dedicated Server build target performs the following optimizations: Deactivates the Audio Subsystem Removes lighting threads Removes some Player loop callbacks Removes GPU-only assets Audio Subsystem The Dedicated Server build target deactivates the Audio Subsystem because builds don’t need audio support when running as a dedicated server. Disabling the Audio Subsystem reduces CPU load. Lighting threads The Dedicated Server build target removes process threads related to lighting because there’s no need to render lighting on a server build.
